name: not-so-basic-worker-test-0fe9cb09ab/worker-actions-v
spec_references: ## Statements: the supported statement list does not include fork statements or named worker declarations.

## Expressions: "[Start action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#start-action)" and "[Wait action](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wait-action)" are supported, but worker send and receive actions are not listed.
reason: The asserted results essentially depend on fork blocks, named workers, and inter-worker send/receive actions, none of which appear in the subset's positive lists. Supported start/wait actions and runtime:sleep do not establish support for worker creation or message passing. Outputs such as 90, 12, and 65000 require these uncovered worker behaviors.
unsupported_constructs: fork statements and named worker declarations, including nested forks
worker message send (`a -> w2`) and receive (`<- w1`) actions
test_design_notes: The test additionally asserts selected-worker wait completion, shared-state updates, and repeated worker creation; the uncovered worker constructs suffice for the whole-case feature classification.
io:println calls only expose expected outputs; runtime:sleep and value:toString are explicitly supported.
